concept.title: From Noise to Execution-Ready Signal
concept.target_icp: Active traders seeking actionable, low-latency trade ideas backed by crowd consensus
concept.hook: Split screen: left side chaotic signal feed, right side clean CrowdWisdom execution panel
concept.story: A trader toggles between raw signal noise and CrowdWisdom filtered consensus, watches the confidence metric rise as aligned traders increase, then clicks Execute to send a pre-validated order to their broker

scenes.visuals: Split screen: left shows chaotic signal feed (flashing red/green arrows, conflicting text alerts), right shows blank CrowdWisdom panel with only axes and labels
scenes.narration: Raw signals overwhelm with noise and contradiction.
scenes.sound: Left: dissonant electronic glitches; right: silence

scenes.visuals: Trader's hand moves to toggle view; right panel now shows CrowdWisdom consensus gauge (needle at 40%) and arrow pointing slightly up
scenes.narration: They switch to CrowdWisdom's filtered view.
scenes.sound: Soft toggle click; left glitches fade slightly

scenes.visuals: Close-up of CrowdWisdom gauge: needle rising to 60%, 80% as more traders align; consensus arrow strengthens
scenes.narration: As the crowd aligns, confidence builds.
scenes.sound: Harmonic tone rises in pitch and purity
scenes.music: Motif becomes more cohesive and uplifting

scenes.visuals: Trader's finger hovers over the 'Execute' button, which glows green; left panel still noisy but ignored
scenes.narration: At 90% confidence, the path is clear to trade.
scenes.sound: Left glitches diminish; right tone peaks

scenes.visuals: Button press: confirmation screen shows order details (symbol, amount, pre-validated) and a checkmark
scenes.narration: One click sends a pre-validated order to their broker.
scenes.music: Melody resolves into a uplifting chord

scenes.visuals: CrowdWisdom logo and text: 'Consensus that you can trade on' appears
scenes.text: Consensus that you can trade on
scenes.music: Chord holds, then begins to fade

scenes.visuals: CTA button: 'Trade the consensus' pulses at bottom right

concept.narration: When the crowd agrees, the path forward is clear. CrowdWisdom turns consensus into execution-ready trades
concept.visual_direction: Left side saturated, jittery visual noise; right side cool-toned interface with gauge, consensus arrow, and one-click execution
concept.sound_direction: Left: dissonant electronic glitches; right: harmonic tone that rises with confidence, concluding with a soft confirmation click
concept.music_direction: Evolving motif: starts fragmented, resolves into a cohesive, uplifting melody as consensus builds
concept.minimal_text: Consensus that you can trade on
evidence: Based on ad promise of accounts starting at $36 and ICP of traders seeking reliable signals; value proposition aligns with structured crowd intelligence and filtering
